exempt.Poub.DifftestMain: the poub-difftest executable's entry point, one line; it serves Poub.Difftest.table, audited under Poub.Difftest, through the difftest server's line protocol: a test and not a proof
exempt.Poub.VerifierMain: the poub-verifier executable's entry point, one line; it runs Poub.Verifier.serve, audited under Poub.Verifier
exempt.Poub.ProtocolMain: the poub-protocol executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of Poub.Protocol.protocol, audited under Poub.Protocol and CoreProtocol

Poub.why: the verifier is code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes and hm96, core's randomness, the core protocol interface its session is a component through (Poub.Protocol), and PoUS's leaf and path check (PousCheck.Merkle, on which a P2 store's openings are checked, Poub.P2); no Mathlib and nothing of Security. The difftest's table (Poub.Difftest) also imports the difftest server
